title: Remove resource leases and the host obligation-waive operation
outcome: The host control protocol no longer offers resource leases or obligation waive; TermAl removes its matching waiver surface in coordination.
acceptance: An open bound obligation can still be cleared by revising or dropping its binding
LeaseAcquire, LeaseRelease and ObligationWaive are gone from the host control protocol, with their storage and control code
TermAl removes its matching obligation-waive adapter, route and helper surface in coordination, with host-owned validation recorded
The leases table is dropped only in an approved store conversion; otherwise it stays
behavioral-control-plane.md, host-checklist.md, shipped.md and the roadmap no longer present resource leases as shipped
